nodes.label: Custom Icon Font Design
nodes.rationale: Introduces IconMode::Custom using private-use Unicode codepoints in a bundled TTF; Unicode/ASCII fallbacks preserved; opt-in only since terminal controls font.

nodes.label: IconMode
nodes.rationale: Enum controlling icon rendering: Ascii → Unicode → Custom/NerdFont; single source of truth for icon selection; fallback chain preserved; user sets via config.toml icon_mode key.

edges.source_location: Proposed Design §1 Icon set abstraction: Extend IconMode
